limits: Times require matching actual BEGIN and END, not neighboring log messages
Native outcome=ended means scope closed, not success
Self wall time subtracts only recorded direct children, not CPU/SQL time
No self-time attribution without a complete trace; missing ends stay unknown
Parentage is same-thread only; asynchronous roots are not falsely nested
Lifecycle start/finish only; repeated restart cycles and child contexts require separate logs
Start returns may precede asynchronous readiness; keep actual health checks
Nested spans and spans across processes must not be summed
Missing/failed intervals are unknown, never zero
Use logs from one machine and one run; do not concatenate different hosts/runs

gc.scope: Completed pause records only, already inside elapsed time; not additive

limits: Intervals are adjacent milestones, not exclusive bean/SQL times
Started is not readiness or ApplicationRunner completion
Timer origins are inferred from framework-reported durations
Missing milestones change interval boundaries; compare only identical pairs

onlineVerification.scope: Read-only fixed installed record/runtime identity/JAR digest and one loopback health GET; no lifecycle command

postInstallSchema.action: schema is verified only; feature activation and authenticated acceptance remain separate

cloudTests.limitation: JUnit XML not retrieved; API log contains omitted lines. Do not claim full log or method count.

limits: OS thread name java is not an independent JavaThread-to-TID mapping proof
CPU and runqueue are cumulative OS thread counters; not additive to startup steps
Resource sampling begins after JVM exec; 10-second sample cadence
No JVM attach, service control, foreign process signal, heap dump or payload sampling

resourceFollowup.scope: Same Run50 PID; cumulative counters through this observation, not a contemporaneous startup IO sample
